title.context: Settings > card heading: stages of the household's budget, e.g. before and after moving in together.

help.message: Nowy rozdział, kiedy życie się zmienia, np. gdy zamieszkacie razem. Wcześniejsze można schować albo wyłączyć z plannera; nic nie znika.
help.context: Settings > Chapters card: one-line description under the heading.

new.context: Settings > Chapters: corner button that opens the form for starting a chapter.

nameLabel.context: Settings > Chapters form: label of the chapter name field.

nameHelp.message: Czym jest ten rozdział, w kilku słowach.
nameHelp.context: Settings > Chapters form: help under the name field.

namePlaceholder.context: Settings > Chapters form: example name in the empty name field.

startsLabel.context: Settings > Chapters form: label of the start date field.

startsHelp.message: Wszystko wcześniej staje się poprzednim rozdziałem.
startsHelp.context: Settings > Chapters form: help under the start date field.

none.message: Nie ma jeszcze rozdziałów: wszystko to jedna historia.
none.context: Settings > Chapters: shown when no chapter has been started.

current.context: Settings > Chapters list: small tag next to the chapter that is running now.

summary.context: Settings > Chapters list: link text that opens a chapter's summary.

confirmDelete.context: Settings > Chapters list: second tap to delete a chapter (only the chapter, not the expenses).

delete.context: Settings > Chapters list: accessible label of the delete button; {name} is the chapter name.

before.context: Name of the time before the first chapter; {name} is the first chapter's name.

until.context: Chapter dates when it has no start; {date} is a long date, e.g. '31 August 2026'.

since.context: Chapter dates for the running chapter; {date} is a long date.

between.context: Chapter dates: first and last day, long dates.

showPastHelp.message: W Historii, Analizach, kategoriach i widżetach. Wyłączone: wszystko zaczyna się od początku tego rozdziału.
showPastHelp.context: Settings > Chapters: help under the 'show past chapters' switch.

inPlannerHelp.message: Typowe kwoty, podpowiedzi limitów i typowy miesiąc uczą się też z nich. Wyłączone: tylko z tego rozdziału.
inPlannerHelp.context: Settings > Chapters: help under the 'plan from past chapters' switch.

eyebrow.context: Chapter summary screen: small label above the chapter name.

loadFailed.context: Chapter summary: shown when loading fails; {error} is the technical message.

empty.message: W tym rozdziale nic nie zapisano.
empty.context: Chapter summary: shown when the chapter has no expenses or income.

spent.context: Chapter summary: tile and legend label for money spent.

income.context: Chapter summary: tile, legend and table label for income.

noIncome.context: Chapter summary: note under the income tile when no income was logged.

saved.context: Chapter summary: tile label, income minus spending when positive.

shortBy.context: Chapter summary: tile label when spending exceeded income.

savingsRate.context: Chapter summary: note under the left-over tile: the savings rate.

perMonth.context: Chapter summary: tile and table label for average monthly spending.

incomePerMonth.context: Chapter summary: note under the average tile; {amount} is average monthly income.

average.context: Chapter summary: legend and tooltip label for the average month line.

monthsTitle.context: Chapter summary: chart title, spending per month.

monthsHeadline.context: Chapter summary month-by-month headline; {month} is a month name (Polish nominative), {year} a year. Keep the <b> tags.

inOutTitle.context: Chapter summary: chart title, income next to spending per month.

inOutHeadline.message: {plus} z {count} miesięcy skończyło się na plusie.
inOutHeadline.context: Chapter summary money in/out headline; {plus} and {count} are numbers of months. Keep the <b> tags.

left.context: Chapter summary: tooltip and table column, income minus spending for a month.

yearsTitle.context: Chapter summary: chart title, average monthly spending per year of the chapter.

yearsUp.message: Miesiąc kosztował {percent}% więcej w {last} niż w {first}.
yearsUp.context: Chapter summary years headline; {first} and {last} are year labels like '2023/24'. Keep the <b> tags.

yearsDown.message: Miesiąc kosztował {percent}% mniej w {last} niż w {first}.
yearsDown.context: Chapter summary years headline; {first} and {last} are year labels like '2023/24'. Keep the <b> tags.

year.context: Chapter summary: table column, the year of the chapter.

monthsCol.context: Chapter summary: table column, number of months logged in the year.

inYear.context: Chapter summary: tooltip label, total spent in the year.

yearsNote.message: Lata liczone są po dwanaście miesięcy od pierwszego miesiąca rozdziału. Średnia na miesiąc, więc krótszy ostatni rok też da się porównać.
yearsNote.context: Chapter summary: note under the year-by-year chart.

whereHeadline.context: Chapter summary donut headline; {name} is a category name, {share} a percentage. Keep the <b> tags.

changeTitle.context: Chapter summary: chart title, change per category between the first and last year.

changeUp.message: Największy wzrost: {name}, o {amount} miesięcznie więcej w {last} niż w {first}.
changeUp.context: Chapter summary change headline; {name} a category, {amount} money, {first}/{last} year labels. Keep the <b> tags.

changeDown.message: Największy spadek: {name}, o {amount} miesięcznie mniej w {last} niż w {first}.
changeDown.context: Chapter summary change headline; {name} a category, {amount} money, {first}/{last} year labels. Keep the <b> tags.

changeNote.message: Średnio miesięcznie w pierwszym roku rozdziału wobec ostatniego.
changeNote.context: Chapter summary: note under the change-by-category chart.

biggestTitle.context: Chapter summary: list title, the ten largest single expenses.

weekdayNote.message: Bez wydatków od {amount} w górę, żeby czynsz nie wygrał żadnego dnia.
weekdayNote.context: Chapter summary: note under the weekday chart; {amount} is an amount with currency.

incomePartial.message: Wpływy są zapisane za {count} z {months} miesięcy; to, co zostało, liczone jest tylko z nich.
incomePartial.context: Chapter summary: note under the tiles when income exists for only some months.

overMonths.context: Chapter summary: note under a tile; {count} is a number of months.

counted.context: Chapter summary: line under the tiles; {formatted} is the number of expenses formatted, {months} the number of months.
